description: [Compliance & counterparty] See what changed on official sanctions lists since your last check. Use when re-screening customers against new designations or monitoring list updates. Price: $0.05 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/sanctions-changes

change_types.description: Comma-separated subset of added, changed, removed (default all).

limit.description: Max change records returned 1-2000 (default 500); oldest first.

lists.description: Comma-separated: OFAC, EU, UK (or OFAC_SDN, OFAC_CONS, EU_FSF, UK_FCDO). Default: all.

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time; returns changes our snapshots detected after it. Default: 24 hours ago.

name: sanctions_changes
title: Sanctions List Changes (OFAC, EU, UK) ($0.05)
